Camp near Palmeth. Va Dee. 8lh

1562. -

Dear friendą On Teles return timers, ant I emprese the of partenely to sent a line ly him lo you not peeleny quile eclain e pasted maller inches decelly when sent frem the Arm We reached aquia Creek safely esi The line anticipated, and to my great joy learned immediatel, that ore ole friene nai) Mall (of the 2111 was 2. Maste as som as the Boat was unluaded he came on ivard cence spent the remainder of the even with me, eve had a hume chat d arre fore - semaine lill the nest day, sent a lll of upfles ete up ta the Captis quarters, and ivecede enth the remainds of on luggage fu which it is needles to say read Conopolden
